lawRefs: N.C.G.S. § 105-153.7 (rate 3.99% for taxable years beginning in 2026 and after; S.L. 2023-134)
N.C.G.S. § 105-153.5(a)(1) (standard deduction); (a1) (child deduction); (b) (Social Security and Bailey deductions)
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Values hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. Rate: NCDOR tax rate schedule: 3.99% for tax years 2026 and after (4.25% for 2025); possible further cuts from 2027 depend on revenue triggers. Standard deduction (statutory, not indexed): $12,750 single and married filing separately, $25,500 married filing jointly / surviving spouse, $19,125 head of household (NCDOR standard deduction page, https://www.ncdor.gov/taxes-forms/individual-income-tax/north-carolina-standard-deduction-or-north-carolina-itemized-deductions, lists these for 2025; Tax Foundation 2026 shows the same $12,750 / $25,500 for 2026). No personal exemption and no additional deduction for age 65+; an AGI-tested child deduction is not modeled. Starts from federal AGI. Social Security and railroad retirement benefits are deducted in full. Retirement income: no general exclusion; government retirement benefits covered by the Bailey settlement and military retired pay are deductible (not modeled). No capital-gains exclusion. No local income taxes. Cross-checked against Tax Foundation, "State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026" (data as of Jan 1 2026, updated Feb 11 2026).
